checks.detail: The sample search row has one final standard 32px inspector action: vertical three dots. The standalone search action is absent.
Enter on the point input is the only submit gesture; empty Enter resets the first page.
Successful point loads do not leave persistent copy. Only compact validation/provider errors may render inline.
The final three-dot trigger opens the existing 244px eye/eye-off menu and keeps the v41 optional-column inventory.
Mocks and the design renderer use start_offset, end_offset, next_cursor and total as the authoritative page fields.
Multiply and Custom are not added; FFT remains excluded; production, backend, tests, Git and runtime are untouched.
